title: Prime Minister announces ex-gratia from PMNRF for the victims of the unfortunate incident in Lakhisarai, Bihar
body_text: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi has announced an ex-gratia from the Prime Minister's National Relief Fund (PMNRF) of Rs. 2 lakh for the next of kin of each deceased, along with Rs. 50,000 for the injured in the unfortunate incident in Lakhisarai, Bihar. In a post on X, the Prime Minister's Office shared: "PM @narendramodi has announced an ex-gratia of Rs. 2 lakh from PMNRF to be given to the next of kin of each deceased in the unfortunate incident in Lakhisarai, Bihar. The injured would be given Rs. 50,000. PM @narendramodi has announced an ex-gratia of Rs. 2 lakh from PMNRF to be given to the next of kin of each deceased in the unfortunate incident in Lakhisarai, Bihar. The injured would be given Rs. 50,000. https://t.co/MpnGrBgvQD — PMO India (@PMOIndia) August 17, 2026 *** MJPS/SS/PRK (Release ID: 2300407) Visitor Counter : 269 Read this release in: Urdu , Marathi , हिन्दी , Bengali , Bengali-TR , Assamese , Punjabi , Tamil , Telugu , Kannada , Malayalam

enrichment.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced ex-gratia compensation from the Prime Minister's National Relief Fund (PMNRF) for victims of an unspecified unfortunate incident in Lakhisarai, Bihar. The compensation is Rs. 2 lakh for the next of kin of each deceased and Rs. 50,000 for those injured. The announcement was made via a PMO post on X.
enrichment.context: The PMNRF is a fund used by the Prime Minister to provide immediate relief to families of those affected by natural calamities like floods, cyclones, earthquakes, and also major accidents and disturbances such as fires, boat capsizes, riots, and terrorist attacks. It is financed entirely through voluntary public contributions and does not draw from government budgetary sources, allowing the PM to sanction relief quickly without parliamentary appropriation processes. Such ex-gratia announcements are routine following incidents causing casualties across India and follow a fairly standard compensation pattern.
